input.quote: Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer.
input.rationale: Preferred position met: once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, business hours, off-site where practicable via an independent auditor under confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no direct access to Customer systems or unrelated data.
